build_strict_monotonic_alignment: build a python module to compute optimal monotonic alignment from a pairwise similarity matrix using Needleman-Wunsch
build_segment_intersection_connection: build a sparse CSR connectivity matrix where each entry indicates if two time segments intersect
build_contains_matrix: build a sparse CSR matrix where each entry indicates if one time segment contains another
generate_ngrams: generate n-gram pairs from a list of words with configurable min and max depth
convert_wav_to_arrow_array: convert a list of PyTorch WAV segment tensors into a chunked PyArrow array for efficient storage
